slides.title: Patient Centricity Has a Precise Working Definition
bullets: An organizational culture that places patients at the centre of decisions
Responds to needs patients articulate themselves
Changes what counts as good scientific work for Medical Affairs

slides.title: From Thinking About the Pill to Thinking About Health
bullets: Considers the physical, mental, social and emotional sides of a condition
A drug can hit its trial endpoint and still fail patients in daily life
MSLs hear directly from clinicians how treatment plays out for real patients

slides.title: Health Value Means More Than "Does It Work"
bullets: Asks whether the drug improves outcomes and experience patients care about
Delivered in a system that can sustain that improvement
Patient-reported outcomes and quality-of-life measures make it measurable

slides.title: Three Ways It Changes an MSL's Practice
bullets: Adherence-barrier or subgroup observations count as valuable insights
Justifies partnering with patient advocacy groups where compliant
Reshapes evidence-generation priorities to include patient-reported endpoints

slides.title: Ask What the Conversation Changes for the Patient
bullets: Keep patient centricity genuinely operational, not decorative
Every scientific exchange should trace back to the patient behind the prescription

takeaway.title: Patient centricity reframes medical value around what actually matters to patients, not just trial endpoints
bullets: Health value means outcomes and experience, not only efficacy
Adherence and quality-of-life observations are genuine medical insights
Every scientific exchange should trace back to patient impact
takeaway.nextLesson: Medical Affairs as a translator between science, clinical practice and strategy
